factor_dict.ACCT_OHLSON_OSCORE:
equity = d['每股净资产'] * d['总股本']
dr = d['资产负债率'].replace(0, np.nan)
TA = equity / (1 - dr.clip(upper=0.99))
tlta = d['资产负债率']
wcta = d['营运资金'] / TA
ca_to_ta = d['流动资产/总资产']
cl_to_tl = d['流动负债/负债合计']
clca = (cl_to_tl / ca_to_ta) * dr
NI = d['扣非净利润']
nita = NI / TA
oeneg = (equity < 0).astype(float)
chin = (NI - NI.shift(252)) / (NI.abs() + NI.shift(252).abs()).replace(0, np.nan)
Z = ((NI < 0) | (NI.shift(252) < 0)).astype(float)
O = -1.32 - 0.407*np.log(TA.replace(0, np.nan)) + 6.03*tlta - 1.43*wcta + 0.076*clca - 1.72*oeneg + 0.035*nita - 0.521*chin - 0.267*Z
out = O
factor_dict.ACCT_MOHANRAM_GSCORE:
gm = d['销售毛利率']
cogs_to_ta = d['销售成本率'] * d['总资产周转率']
rev_ps = d['每股营业收入']
equity = d['每股净资产'] * d['总股本']
dr = d['资产负债率'].replace(0, np.nan)
TA = equity / (1 - dr.clip(upper=0.99))
NI = d['扣非净利润']
accruals = (NI - d['每股经营现金流净额'] * d['总股本']) / TA
gmi = (gm.shift(252) / gm).gt(1).astype(float)
aqi = ((1 - cogs_to_ta) / (1 - cogs_to_ta.shift(252))).gt(1).astype(float)
sgi = (rev_ps / rev_ps.shift(252)).gt(1).astype(float)
sgai = (d['销售费用率'] / d['销售费用率'].shift(252)).gt(1).astype(float)
lvgi = (d['资产负债率'] / d['资产负债率'].shift(252)).gt(1).astype(float)
tata = accruals.gt(0).astype(float)
G = gmi + aqi + sgi + sgai + lvgi + tata
out = G
